map.按标价与折扣率测算实售价、优惠额与等效折数。: From the list price and discount rate, work out the net sale price, the concession amount and the equivalent discount level.

map.实售价 = 标价×(1−折扣率): Net sale price = list price × (1 − discount rate)
map.💡 实售价 = 标价 ×（1 − 折扣率）；优惠额 = 标价 × 折扣率；等效折: 💡 Net sale price = list price × (1 − discount rate); concession amount = list price × discount rate; equivalent discount level = (1 − discount rate) × 10.
map.开发商促销时算折后实收价。: Work out net proceeds after discount during a developer promotion.
map.渠道佣金与折扣叠加后的净回款。: See net receipts once channel commission and discounts are stacked.
map.对比不同折扣力度的去化效果。: Compare absorption at different discount depths.
map.原价 100 万、折扣系数 0.9 → 实收=100×0.9=90 万；本工具成: List price of 1 million yuan at a discount factor of 0.9 gives net proceeds of 100 × 0.9 = 900,000; in cost mode this tool outputs total = A × B.
map.若再减渠道费 2 万、税费由买方承担，开发商净回款 88 万；折扣每降 1 个百: Deducting a further 20,000 of channel commission with taxes borne by the buyer leaves the developer 880,000 net; each extra percentage point of discount costs about 10,000, so weigh it against faster absorption.
map.二者都侵蚀利润，应合并看净回款，避免渠道用返佣变相突破折扣红线。: Both erode margin, so look at net proceeds together and stop channels using rebates to break through the discount floor.
map.怎么定折扣力度？: How should discount depth be set?
map.按去化目标与毛利底线反推，常见 95–98 折引流、特价房 90 折以内清库存。: Work back from the absorption target and the gross margin floor; 95-98 percent of list is common to draw traffic, with special units below 90 percent to clear stock.
